name: Akigase Nozomi
source: The protagonist's classmate and the discipline committee chairman. Forthright and serious, and as the chairman, she also has natural arrogance. But despite all that, she still has an interest in love as with all girls her age. Once she decides on the guy she wants, she will wholeheartedly try to win him over. She will not listen to the protagonist as she sees him as an eyesore.
